help_title: A little help along the way
help_body: Choose a shop and agree a written quote. Choose a suitable delivery partner and confirm the fee. At pickup, the shop gives its code to the partner; at delivery, the buyer gives a different code. Only share a code when you receive or hand over the parcel. The order timeline shows the next step. To call, open a conversation and allow your microphone. If calls are unavailable, send a message.
offline_body: Reconnect to see shops, messages, and the latest order updates. Orders cannot be completed offline.

terms_waiting: If a buyer is unavailable, contact them twice and wait 15 minutes. A return or extra fee needs their agreement or reviewer approval.
